title: T-1 list with prefix returns every key under the prefix with metadata shape intact
iWant: facade.list({prefix}) to return every key under a prefix with the metadata shape intact
soThat: the applied project can enumerate feature flags, sessions, or any prefix-scoped collection through one seam

acceptanceCriteria.description: The list-with-prefix probe puts 10 keys under the prefix flags/ (each with a metadata blob) and calls facade.list({prefix: flags/}). The result returns all 10 keys, each entry carrying {name, metadata}, and every name preserves the domain-visible key (without the fixture keyPrefix if one was set).
acceptanceCriteria.given: 10 keys put under a shared prefix through the facade
acceptanceCriteria.then: the result carries 10 entries with correct name and metadata fields; the aggregate probe verdict is pass
